registration.decision: 02:15 UTC on each climate date for every city. Prices available by that common time only.
registration.allocation: One contract side per city; whole quantities. Multiple-choice knapsack maximizes model expected dollars under shared spendable cash; equal-budget baseline divides spendable cash across eligible cities. Freeze selections before delayed quotes, no reranking or replacement. Delayed entries cannot exceed signal allocation budget or planned quantity.
registration.settlement_availability: Next-day 11AM America/New_York or archived CLI issuance, whichever later; assumed availability, not historically verified.
limitations: Known outcomes: results are retrospective, not independent validation.
Display-price quotes do not prove depth or fills.
Current fee scenario, historical fee schedule unverified.
